title: Omakase sushi — Ginza and around
brief: Omakase counters to try, compared with Sushi Suzuki (included first, as the benchmark). Lunch is fine; no tempura. Prices are per person.
notes: Availability wasn't checked anywhere. Michelin claims come from press summaries and need checking on guide.michelin.com. Where a 日本語 address is street-only, I transcribed it from the English address. Four places at the end have no address yet; their Google Maps button searches by name and neighbourhood.

places.name: Sushi Suzuki
places.address_en: 5F Ginza Bijutsukan Bldg, 6-5-6 Ginza, Chuo-ku, Tokyo
places.address_ja: 東京都中央区銀座6-5-6 銀座美術館ビル 5F
places.summary: Chef Takao Suzuki's Ginza counter (12 years at Sushi Aoki): Edomae sushi on red-vinegar (akazu) rice. Moved to 6-5-6 Ginza in August 2024.

practical.price: Lunch nigiri course ¥26,620; dinner omakase ¥54,450 — tax included, from 1 Jul 2026 (jpneazy)
practical.reservation: Phone 03-5537-6868, or a jpneazy concierge request (jpneazy adds its own fee)

research.why: The benchmark. Tabelog Award Bronze (2024 and 2026); Tabelog Sushi Tokyo Hyakumeiten 2025.
research.notes: Previously at 5F Ginza Nohgakudo Bldg, 6-5-15 Ginza.
open_questions: Confirm this is the right Sushi Suzuki ('Roppongi Suzuki' is a different restaurant).
One guide calls it Michelin one-star; not found on guide.michelin.com.
Is a service charge added? How much is jpneazy's fee?

places.name: Ginza Sushi Aoki
places.address_en: 4F Dai-3 Iwatsuki Bldg, 6-7-7 Ginza, Chuo-ku, Tokyo
places.address_ja: 東京都中央区銀座6-7-7 第3岩月ビル 4F
places.summary: Second-generation Ginza sushi house run by Toshikatsu Aoki: roots in Kyoto (1972), in Ginza since 1992, at this site since August 2022.

practical.hours: Lunch 12:00–14:00 (last order 13:00 or 13:30); dinner from 17:00 (last order 21:30)
practical.closed: No regular closing day except New Year
practical.price: Course prices not found. Tabelog bands: lunch ¥10,000–14,999, dinner ¥20,000–29,999

research.why: Sushi Suzuki's chef trained here for 12 years, so the style should be the closest to the benchmark, at the lowest price band here. Tabelog Sushi Tokyo Hyakumeiten 2021 and 2022; Tabelog 3.73. Tabelog Magazine (2022) called it star-awarded, with good-value weekday lunches.
open_questions: Current course prices (a course called '立涌' appears in listings without a price).
Michelin status: called starred by Tokyo Cheapo and Tabelog Magazine (2022); not found on guide.michelin.com.
Tabelog also lists 050-5871-0533. Which line takes bookings?
